source='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])\n    # Restore the fixed outer frame where the mask crosses it.\n    for r in range(min(2, h)):\n        for c in range(w):\n            out[r][c] = 1\n    if h > 2:\n        for c in range(w):\n            out[2][c] = 1 if c < 2 else 4\n    for r in range(3, h):\n        for c in range(min(3, w)):\n            out[r][c] = 1 if c < 2 else 4\n        # The colored field repeats horizontally; infer its period and phase\n        # from the unmasked cells in this row.\n        vals = [(c, grid[r][c]) for c in range(3, w) if grid[r][c] != 0]\n        if not vals:\n            continue\n        best = None\n        for p in range(2, 11):\n            groups = {}\n            for c, v in vals:\n                groups.setdefault(c % p, Counter())[v] += 1\n            score = sum(max(counts.values()) for counts in groups.values())\n            # Prefer the shortest period when support ties.\n            cand = (score, -p, p, groups)\n            if best is None or cand[:2] > best[:2]:\n                best = cand\n        p, groups = best[2], best[3]\n        phase = {k: counts.most_common(1)[0][0] for k, counts in groups.items()}\n        for c in range(3, w):\n            if out[r][c] == 0 and c % p in phase:\n                out[r][c] = phase[c % p]\n    return out\n'''
